text:
Maya PM: Quick sync — postlaunch: we have a streaming regression reported by two customers and one UX crash. Need a hotfix playbook. Propose: 1) triage priority bug (P0), 2) patch branch + small rollback-safe change, 3) rolling canary to 5% then 25%, 4) customer comms template. Thoughts?
Ethan Eng: Can you drop repro steps / logs? I pulled traces and see KV-cache miss spikes; might be batching edge-case. If it's cache corruption that's P0.
Maya PM: Repros attached in support ticket #3421 — short sample: high concurrency with long prompts. Support says 3% of requests error.
Sam SRE: Observability: correlates with a GC spike on worker nodes 11-13 around 11:02 PST. Rolling restart helped briefly. We should avoid full restart if possible.
Priya Design: UX crash is on iOS webview, likely unrelated to server side but we should coordinate a short client patch if needed.
Ethan Eng: Plan: quick fix = tighten KV cache eviction window + extra guard. If we ship that, no schema change. I can have a patch in 2 hours, test in canary.
Maya PM: Decision matrix: ship quick fix (low blast) vs revert streaming rollout (high customer impact). My vote = quick fix + 5% canary. If canary shows >0.5% errors escalate to rollback.
Priya Design: Also prepare a small UI message for affected customers: "We're investigating intermittent failures; temporary workaround: shorten prompt length when possible." Short and non-alarming.
Ethan Eng: Agree. I'll open PR and tag for review. @Sam SRE can you prepare the canary routing (5% traffic) and health checks? Add a short smoke test: 100 concurrent ~30s prompts.
Sam SRE: On it. I'll script canary: route via canary flag, health-check endpoint /healthz?smoke=1 returns token stats. Will monitor latency+error rate.
Maya PM: Customer comms draft: "We're aware of intermittent streaming errors for some large prompts; engineers are deploying a targeted fix now. ETA 1-2 hrs for canary, 4 hrs for full rollout. We'll update in this thread." Approve?
Priya Design: Approve. Add support link and proactive outreach to 2 impacted customers.
Ethan Eng: PR #6789 created: branch hotfix/kv-eviction. Tests: unit + integration. Requesting expedited review.
Maya PM: Approving expedited review. If canary looks good for 30m, we roll to 25% then 100% over 2 hours.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotfix/kv-eviction -> canary group (5%) by Sam SRE at 1788882235.
Sam SRE: Canary live. Initial 15m window. Smoke test running.
Ethan Eng: Smoke test pass locally. Watching logs.
Sam SRE: Canary 15m: error rate down from 3% -> 0.4%, latency stable. Proceed to 25%? 
Maya PM: Proceed. Notify the two customers that we've started rollout and share workaround.
Priya Design: Done — messages sent.
Ethan Eng: Rolling to 25% now.
Sam SRE: 25% stable after 20m. Metrics look good. ETA to full: 90 minutes if no regressions.
Maya PM: OK move to full. After full rollout, we schedule postmortem + checklist item to add targeted unit tests for long-prompt KV scenarios.
Ethan Eng: Agreed. I'll open follow-up issue for increased test coverage and a mitigation playbook.
Maya PM: Thanks team. I'll update the support ticket and close this thread once postmortem is scheduled.
